properties.description: The instructions a VS Code agent works from where MCP is blocked: the two verbs (`reflow2 read` for every read, `reflow2 write` for writes), the exit codes, prose on stdin, what to do after a refusal, the person's word on intent. `reflow2 init --harness vscode-cli` writes it to .github/instructions/reflow2.instructions.md, and the binary serves the same text as get_instructions section `vscode-terminal-route`.
properties.name: reflow2.instructions.md (VS Code terminal route)
